Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.service

Class TransportService

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.service.TransportService
public class TransportService extends Object
Household transport: monthly public transport and flight figures, plus the household's vehicles (US-18, US-19, US-14).

Every change is written to the household's activity history and triggers a score recalculation. Edits record the previous and new values.

  • Method Details

    • recordEntry

      public TransportEntry recordEntry(User actor, Household household, double publicTransportTripsPerWeek, double flightsPerYear)
      US-18: record the household's transport information for the current period. Transport has one reading per month, so recording again in the same month replaces that month's figures rather than adding a second entry.
      Parameters:
      actor - the user recording the figures
      household - the household they belong to
      publicTransportTripsPerWeek - average public transport trips per week
      flightsPerYear - flights taken per year
      Returns:
      the saved entry for the current month (YYYY-MM)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either figure is negative

    • addVehicle

      public Vehicle addVehicle(User actor, Household household, String label, String fuelType, double kmPerWeek)
      US-18: add a vehicle to the household. Vehicles are listed on the Transport tab; the transport score itself is currently based on trips and flights only.
      Parameters:
      actor - the user adding the vehicle
      household - the household it belongs to
      label - a name for the vehicle, e.g. "Family car"
      fuelType - e.g. "Petrol", "Diesel", "Electric"
      kmPerWeek - average distance driven per week, in km
      Returns:
      the saved vehicle
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the label or fuel type is blank, or the distance is negative

    • updateVehicle

      public Vehicle updateVehicle(User actor, Household household, long vehicleId, String label, String fuelType, double kmPerWeek)
      US-19: update an existing household vehicle. The history message shows the old and new label, fuel type and distance.
      Parameters:

      household - the household the vehicle belongs to
      vehicleId - the vehicle to change
      label - the new name
      fuelType - the new fuel type
      kmPerWeek - the new distance per week, in km
      Returns:
      the updated vehicle
      Throws:
